data.exact_reserve_text: During the period, the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves. These changes have been accounted for prospectively as a change in estimate. As a result of these changes, $7.4m of reserves were released in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a material release of prior year reserves at gross level (approx. 29.1 million) driven primarily by favourable claims development and a prospective change in actuarial methodology (risk margin refinement). The managing agent explicitly states a net release of $7.4m due to the change in estimate. The release is reflected across older underwriting years (2018-2021) as evidenced in the gross claims development triangle.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year gross reserve movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (note 14) as the report does not present an explicit single-line gross movement figure for prior years. The managing agent explicitly reports a net release of $7.4m (net of reinsurance) due to a change in actuarial methodology; gross/net figures therefore differ. Amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD). Where per-LOB prior year movements were not disclosed, LOB movement amounts are left null.
